mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.type != '2' -- 排除按钮类型的菜单 AND m.type IN ('0', '1') -- 只查询目录和菜单 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.type != '2' -- 排除按钮类型的菜单 AND m.type IN ('0', '1') -- 只查询目录和菜单 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
